prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering the onboarding flow and adding preset fallback choices were helpful.
Interactive screen redesigns and desktop hint notifications hurt performance.
Copy changes, guidelines, layout tweaks, and background notifications showed no clear effect.
Predictions for flow reordering and fallback choices were accurate or slightly underestimated.
Predictions were consistently too high for copy changes, guidelines, hint notifications, layout tweaks, and visual redesigns.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +1.2% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: +11.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.0% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -1.4% over 1 test(s)
- finish, notification: -8.9% over 1 test(s)
- home, redesign: -4.5% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +3.9% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: -1.2% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +13.0% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 65.6%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, new_flow] Account Recovery Warning Checklist on Sign-In: Add an account persistence checklist component to the sign-in screen highlighting email matching to prevent duplicate resets. (why: Support mail highlighted 8 cases of pets missing or reset after users signed in again with a different account.)
1: [choose_path, reorder] Story Teaser Prioritization Flow Reorder: Reorder onboarding screens to highlight story narrative choices prior to path selection. (why: The initial path selection drops off at 76.2% with a mean time of 514s; leading with narrative context reduces decision friction.)
2: [home, wait_info] Estimated Generation Time Counter on Waiting Screen: Display explicit progress bars and estimated generation time counters on the waiting screen. (why: The home waiting stage takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to abandonment before completion.)
3: [adoption, incentive] Pet Naming Encouragement Badge on Certificate: Add an official pet adoption badge component to the adoption certificate screen to encourage users to finalize naming. (why: Adoption completion is 65.6%; adding visual identity rewards motivates users through the final step of adoption.)
4: [finish, hint] Desktop Docking System Tray Hint: Add a prominent system tray control hint text on the home introduction screen. (why: Users wrote to support asking how to control, hide, or interact with their pet after completing onboarding.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Outcome Headline Clarification: Rewrite choose_path screen headline and body text to clearly distinguish fast preset pets from custom photo pets. (why: Choose path mean duration is 514s, showing users take excessive time evaluating options without clear expectations.)
6: [adoption, notification] Photo Processing Readiness Notification Toggle: Enable desktop readiness notifications during photo processing on the upload_photos screen. (why: Custom pet generation can stall or take long (adoption mean time 1017s), resulting in dropped sessions or reported generation failures.)
7: [home, layout] Compact Stage Layout for Waiting Screen: Switch the waiting screen layout to 'compact' to streamline visual focus during backend generation. (why: Waiting step mean duration is 2336s; a clean compact view reduces perceived UI complexity while waiting.)

scores.note: Supported by support emails and new flow/reorder changes perform strongly in past tests.
Reordering onboarding flow previously delivered high positive lift on early drop-off steps.
Wait info progress updates previously yielded +3.9% lift on the home screen stage.
High drop-off step, but visual add-ons show limited proven impact.
Support mentions issue, but hint and notification changes consistently hurt metrics.
Copy changes have repeatedly shown zero or negative impact.
High potential step drop-off, but desktop notifications historically degraded performance.
